title: Zeus Juice Mortals - Tooth Fairy 100ml shortfill E-Liquid
description: Tooth Fairy from Zeus Juice’s Mortals collection conjures the whimsical wonder of the sweetshop with a flavour that blends the best flavours of the pick ‘n’ mix counter to produce a mouth-watering taste of delicious nostalgia. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
